pages.text: Grandpa rowed through the market's middle. "Noodles and sightseeing!" Bung stood with a bowl. Ddori sat on a board, hugging a bowl tightly.
The moving boat rocked, and Bung swayed. Broth sloshed to the rim. "It will not spill!" Bung took a step.
A big boat passed with a wave. A big rock—splash! Broth overflowed onto the floor. Bung's bowl was half empty.
Without broth, the remaining noodles stiffened. "No sights, no noodles..." Bung looked sad. Ddori watched, still hugging that bowl.
Grandpa set down his oar and put Bung's bowl on the floorboard. "There is water in your bowl too. Stand, and it sways with you." Bung peered inside.
"Sit to eat, no spills!" Grandpa said behind Bung. Bung sat firmly on the board. The boat rocked, but the broth stayed calm.
Bung held the bowl in both hands and slurped. Another rock as Grandpa rowed, but the broth stayed put. "Sit to eat, no spills!"
Bung drew Ddori's hand close and sat Ddori beside Bung, bowl just before the knees. Both slurped side by side on the moving boat.
Bung set two empty bowls beside each other. "One, sit firmly on the board! Two, bowl before your knees! Three, stay seated until the boat stops!" Seated, Bung looked round the market.
Grandpa stroked Bung's head. Finishing seated left even more time to see the sights. He pulled the oar once. "Sit to eat, no spills!"
